Choose what goes on your drive.

Start with a drive size, choose your collections, then copy the build command. Everything here is a plan. This page runs no commands and downloads no content.

1Pick a starting size

Drive sizes use decimal GB. Presets are starting selections; actual free space is checked by the builder.

2Set up your build

Replace this example with your drive's actual path. OWL builds in place and does not format the drive.

Choose the terminal where you will paste the command.

Generated indexes on the build computer

Original source downloads and partial downloads stay on the selected drive. These separate directories hold generated per-asset indexes and indexing scratch only. Relative paths are resolved from the OWL repository where you run the command.

Keep completed per-asset indexes here to reuse them across library builds. Sources are still read and verified on the selected drive.

Generated extraction scratch and resumable checkpoints. Keep this directory between interrupted runs.

Separate from the finished drive's search allowance. Starts at this preset's search allowance: 2,000,000,000 bytes (2 GB) for 16 GB. Existing cached indexes count toward this limit.

    Unmet budget is an allowance for missing scope, not downloadable files or an exact size for missing documents. Extraction uses your index workspace; the temporary assembled index and finished search stay on the drive. The retained index cache is additional space, separate from the in-place reference. Run the plan command to check actual directories and shared filesystems.

    Search is built in phases. After verifying the temporary index, OWL releases its extraction database before generating browser search files. The peak uses the larger phase; the search and temporary-work rows are not simultaneous allocations.

        Incomplete collections

          Take this plan to your terminal

          Run these from the installed OWL repository. Check the path before pasting. Nothing runs from this page.

          Shows requirements and checks the destination's available space.

          Starts a saved background job that downloads, indexes, and verifies selected files. Keep the computer awake and SSD attached.

          Choose editions, not guessed compression

          Smaller options select verified published editions when available. Unverified alternate editions stay disabled. Critical knowledge remains in ordinary readable files; large archives may need bundled readers.

          “Preset files only” selects that preset's pinned sources. Its formats may include ordinary documents and reader-dependent archives. “Published collection” requests its wider collection scope, which may still be incomplete.
